whyItMatters: java XPath assembles from parts (xp.evaluate("//u[@id='" + i + "']", d)), so input quotes rewrite the query.
actions: Bind values as variables with XPathVariableResolver.
If binding is unavailable, quote-escape values before interpolation.
Re-run the scan and confirm no raw interpolation remains.
